title: NVIDIA Stock Investors... Elon Musk Just Delivered HUGE News!!
creator: Jose Najarro Stocks
summary: Jose Najarro treats Elon Musk's SpaceXAI/xAI earnings commentary (auto-captions render the company as 'SpaceX' throughout, and Nebius as 'Debbie') and a Super Micro pre-announcement as a bullish win for AI and semiconductor investors. Super Micro raised fiscal Q1 2027 revenue guidance to $18.5–19.5B — about a $4B, or 26.7%, increase — and gross margin guidance to 12–12.5% from 10.4–10.8%, which he reads as huge server demand with pricing power ahead of full results on 3 November. On xAI he cites about 1.7 GW of active compute at 30 September, roughly 2 GW by end-October and 2.5 GW by year-end, about 13 GW targeted by the end of next year, roughly 200,000 Nvidia GB300s coming online per month, a $500B–$1T ARR projection for end-2027, roughly $40B of Q4 capex, and sub-one-year (potentially six-month) payback on new compute. His read-through: if xAI spends at that pace, hyperscaler capex guidance above $300B next year is plausible, so he stays bullish and calm on the industry. Calls: NVDA — BUY reiterated, no price stated (up about 2% on the day); SMCI — UNCERTAIN (bullish coverage, no explicit buy stated); META — UNCERTAIN (expects a bullish earnings report tomorrow in the video's timeframe, no explicit buy stated). CoreWeave, Nebius, Iren, Amazon, AMD, Intel and Micron appear only in a green-day price roundup, with no calls.

calls.thesis: Remains bullish and calm on Nvidia and the AI industry: SpaceXAI/xAI (captions render it 'SpaceX') is scaling compute fast (1.7 GW active end-Sep, ~2 GW end-Oct, 2.5 GW by year-end, ~13 GW targeted by end of next year, ~200,000 GB300s coming online per month), Super Micro raised its guide sharply on server demand, and new compute deployments are reportedly paying back in under a year — he reads all of it as proof AI GPU demand is still extreme.
calls.price_at_call: No share price stated; Nvidia up about 2% on the day in the video's market roundup
